task: Locate the latest paper on ArXiv within the 'Nonlinear Sciences - Chaotic Dynamics' category, summarize the abstract and note the submission date.
answer: Latest paper in arXiv Nonlinear Sciences - Chaotic Dynamics (nlin.CD): 'Three-Wave Forced Hasegawa--Wakatani Model: Reducing Chaos with Zonal Flows' (arXiv:2610.38792) by P. Haerter, R. L. Viana, I. L. Caldas. Submission date: [Submitted on 28 Oct 2026] (v1 submitted Wed, 28 Oct 2026 20:00:44 UTC). Abstract summary: The paper studies resistive drift-wave turbulence using a three-wave truncation of the Hasegawa-Wakatani equations, comparing two triads that differ only by a small tilt of the long-wavelength mode: one zonal (not drivable by the density gradient) and one a weakly driven drift wave. Period maps in the adiabaticity parameter C vs drive show the zonal triad is almost always regular while the non-zonal triad becomes chaotic. Self-consistent gradient feedback (particle source vs turbulent flux erosion) amplifies this contrast, greatly increasing aperiodic states in the non-zonal triad while keeping them negligible in the zonal one. The non-zonal triad reaches chaos via torus breakdown with intermittency, interior crisis and period-doubling, and with a self-consistent gradient via a Neimark-Sacker bifurcation to a phase-locked torus that breaks down abruptly with hysteresis, with chaos persisting up to the largest drive. None of these routes to chaos exist when the long-wavelength mode is zonal, demonstrating that zonal flows reduce/suppress chaos in this system.
